description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractProxyActor for implementing command proxy actors in an Akka-based system. It includes common logic for supervisor strategy, message handling (commands, responses, errors), and integration with external components like pub-sub mediator and statistics actor.

classes.name: AbstractProxyActor
classes.description: An abstract base class for Akka command proxy actors that manages common behaviors, message handling, and supervisions.
